title: Use Frequency for every platform design selection

verify.note: Runs the real resolveDesign and the real redirects() body across five selections (unset, empty, unknown, dawn, frequency); fails if resolveDesign can return anything but frequency.

detail: Daniel retired DAWN as a deployable site design and required Frequency to be fully implemented. Missing, unknown and retired platform selectors choose Frequency; the local CLI rejects the retired selection before any environment write; generated active stylesheets, fonts and manifest colours follow Frequency. Historical registry data, fonts, customer colours, serialized block identifiers and native email fixtures are preserved. Decision recorded in ADR-1877. The earlier status log (provisional compositions, CI and production proof pending at the time) was trimmed in SCAN-1111; the probe above now measures design selection itself.
